messages:
kevin (PM): quick design check-in on model catalog compare. main bets: compact badges, pin rail visibility, and chip overflow behavior. figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz789 (screens: compare-rail-variant)

rachel (Design): thumbs up on pin rail for discoverability. two micro-asks: 1) avoid badge wrapping pushing action buttons, 2) make pin target larger on touch.

ethan (Frontend): for chips we can keep a single row and show a `+N` overflow. implementation: `display:flex; gap:8px; overflow:hidden;` and a button `+3` that opens a menu.

samir (A11y): the `+N` needs `role="button"` and `aria-expanded`. menu items must be keyboard tabbable. also ensure the pin button has `aria-pressed`.

lina (Research): from interviews, PMs want quick glance metrics; SREs want details. suggest density toggle defaulting to compact for general users and full for power users.

rachel (Design): badge idea: show icon + single-letter status in compact mode (e.g., L for latency). hover or popover reveals full metric. keeps rows stable.

ethan (Frontend): popover approach avoids reflow. we'll implement popover opened on hover/focus/click with `aria-haspopup` and escape to close. sample: ```<Popover trigger="focus">Latency: 12ms</Popover>```

samir (A11y): popover must be accessible: move focus into popover if it contains interactive controls, otherwise provide `aria-describedby` so screen readers get details. add `aria-live="polite"` for updating numbers.

rachel (Design): pin placement: left rail sticky to table with icons and tooltips. when screen narrow, rail becomes icon-only. microcopy: tooltip `Pin model to compare`.

ethan (Frontend): responsive rail plan: full rail >= 1000px, collapsed icon rail between 600-999px, hide rail <600px and surface pin in overflow menu. css: `@media` breakpoints. target size 44px for touch.

lina (Research): also test a one-time onboarding pulse pointing to pin rail for new users. keep it subtle and obey reduced-motion.

samir (A11y): pulse must respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. if animated, allow users to dismiss or ignore. ensure it does not steal focus.

rachel (Design): UX decision on badges when there are many: overflow `+N` OR compact stacking. prefer overflow to avoid tall rows. show a small timestamp on hover to indicate metric freshness.

ethan (Frontend): we'll add `data-testid` attrs on badges and overflow for e2e. performance note: live updates every 30s; avoid re-rendering entire row. update inner content only.

kevin (PM): action items: 1) rachel update figma with compact-letter-badges + rail and overflow variant (EOD). 2) ethan prototype popover + `+N` overflow and share link (Thu). 3) samir draft accessibility checklist for pin, popover, and overflow (tomorrow). 4) lina run 3 quick user checks on density preference (next Tue). Sync Fri 9:30am PT.

ui-bot: Prototype published by ethan: https://intranet/proto/compare-compact-193456 (WIP)

ethan (Frontend): prototype link posted. will add keyboard reorder (Ctrl+Arrow) and ARIA attributes.

samir (A11y): happy to run a short screen-reader pass on the prototype Fri morning and post notes here.

kevin (PM): perfect, thanks all :thumbsup:
